{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders only
completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas and cast
completed['revenue_float'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify no NaNs after cleaning
if completed['revenue_float'].isna().sum() > 0:
    raise ValueError("There are still non-numeric revenue values after cleaning.")

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print the result
print("Mean revenue of completed orders:", mean_revenue)"}
